scenes.title: A production test. Not a news report.
scenes.caption: Original graphics. Local narration. No borrowed footage.
scenes.narration: This is a technical test for the Knowledge Network video system, not a news report. Every graphic in this test is drawn locally. No footage or audio from another creator is included.

scenes.title: Evidence before publication
scenes.caption: Research → rights review → quality checks
scenes.narration: A finished file is only one part of publishing. Real stories still need verified sources, accurate scripts, clear rights records, and a review of the finished picture and sound.

scenes.title: A file is not a published video
scenes.caption: Rendering and uploading are separate steps.
scenes.narration: The renderer checks the video dimensions, audio track, duration, and encoding. This test remains unpublished. A successful render does not mean a video has been uploaded, approved, or made public.
